description: This file defines the main application structure and delegate for a macOS app using SwiftUI. It includes app lifecycle management, status bar menu handling, window and view setup, and update management via Sparkle (conditionally compiled). It also contains classes for app delegate, status item interaction, and update control, along with configuration for Sparkle updater and signing verification.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent NSView overlay for intercepting mouse events (clicks and hover) on the status bar icon without taking ownership of the MenuBarExtra. Handles left, right clicks, and hover state changes to forward events to callbacks.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing startup, termination, and handling URLs. It also initializes app state, manages update checks, and prevent multiple instances.

classes.name: UpdateStatus
classes.description: Observable class that keeps track of update availability status, used with Sparkle updater.

classes.name: SparkleUpdaterController
classes.description: Conditional class implementing the update mechanism using Sparkle framework, handling update checks, download statuses, and delegate methods.

methods.name: application(_: NSApplication, open urls: [URL])
methods.description: Handles incoming URL schemes for deep linking, dispatching to shared handler.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching(_:)
methods.description: Performs app setup after launch, including duplicate app check, initializing state, onboarding, update checks, and auto-opening chat if specified via CLI args.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate(_:)
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions like stopping reporters, prompts, and web tunnels before app termination.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded()
methods.description: Schedules onboarding flow if needed based on version check.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance()
methods.description: Checks if another instance of the app is already running based on bundle ID.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded(reason:)
methods.description: Checks whether to prompt user for updates or other prompts (handled within Sparkle updater).
